response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and full-stack skills, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: no Kotlin experience at all, only peripheral/old Java usage (robotics, mobile orchestration tooling), and no mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or JVM-focused application server work. While he has some IDE-adjacent experience (C IDE tooling at National Instruments) and clearly enjoys developer tooling and language internals, none of it is JVM/Kotlin-centric, making him a poor technical match despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Deep, broad software engineering background across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated interest and experience in developer tooling, testing frameworks, and IDE-adjacent work (C IDE at National Instruments, custom test runners/assertion libraries)
Strong communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and community teaching
concerns: No Kotlin experience mentioned anywhere in the resume
No Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience — core required frameworks for this role
Java experience is minimal, dated, and not central to his recent career (last decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang)

key_factors.factor: General interest in dev tooling and IDE-adjacent work
